title: Bean and cheese wrap
steps: Drain and rinse the beans if they come from a tin.
Warm them in a small pan over medium heat with a pinch of cumin, paprika and salt and a splash of water for 2 to 3 minutes, mashing roughly with a fork.
Grate the cheese, slice the tomato and shred the lettuce.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side so it folds without cracking.
Spread the beans down the middle, top with the cheese, tomato and lettuce, fold in the ends and roll up tightly. Cut in half to serve.
